q: How does a Bhiwandi powerloom unit work out electricity CO2 per metre?
title: Bhiwandi powerlooms: CO2 per metre
short: Multiply the month's electricity bill in kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh and divide by metres woven. Read metres from the loom counters or the production register. Yarn bought in is Scope 3 and is usually reported separately from weaving.
audience: Powerloom weavers in the Bhiwandi cluster of Maharashtra

p: kWh from the bill for the weaving shed.
Divide by metres woven in the same month.
If you weave very different fabrics, split by picks or loom hours rather than metres, and say which basis you used.

Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
